reply.analysis: Proven: beta = 28 for N = 406. Lower bound: independent set of size 28 (check passed). Upper bound: linear code M = I + 4A over F_5 whose length meets 28; code_fits, factorization and decoding checks all passed. Only 1 code was tried. Versus baselines: cpsat_alpha also proved alpha = 28 (1.50 s), but cpsat_cover (29, unproven, 120.43 s), frac_cover (29.05, unproven) and f2_minrank_sat (no value, lower 27) did not close the bracket. kushagra_agent reached the same exact result over field 5 in 0.073 s. Our compute_s was 0.066 s, but wall_s was 38.484 s, almost all LLM time (llm_s 38.418), so end to end the agent was about 500x slower than kushagra_agent and slower than cpsat_alpha. Nothing suspicious: the hypothesis had empty params, but the certificate does not depend on it.
